name: compact-catalog-filters
goal: Every catalog has one compact search row with all filters and ordering in an icon-triggered modal

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Feature spec: one search row, modal filters and sorting, persistence and reset.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extended existing collection, shared catalog and workspace cases to open and close filters instead of assuming inline controls.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only b3059fc7; sealed red 45ad72470906e36d31daeb452913b258d398090dde25be285623080c2ae5aaf0 proves missing Filters icon on both hosts.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Both catalogs use the shared FilterDialog with existing Modal, Select and icon components; search remains outside to the left.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen tests and command pass at be9fc949; sealed green 6c13132568ca27bcc2b8db50fafe6f5e885beee0b81ed046c6c8d2109383994a follows test-only b3059fc7.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports check passed: 575 unit tests, types, lint, builds and audit. Browser suites: 65 entity, 76 shell, 9 catalog and 7 shared-renderer cases. Shared impact 13 tests, root types/audit and registry valid. Inspected modal screenshot; 48px toolbar on tablet/mobile, 500px mobile dialog, query-preserving reset and Escape focus verified. Native and aggregate checks remain paused.
